title: Upscale and refine evaluation (umbrella): what actually improves a finished frame
description: Five uncovered todo cards that are all the same open question - which final-pass route is worth shipping - and today each would be evaluated separately against the same models. Grouped by refresh 2026-09-22. Members: MPI-707, MPI-477, MPI-688 (MPI-478 declined 2026-10-18). MPI-578 and MPI-343 moved to MPI-1179 (New Models to Test), 2026-10-18.
